title: First time animating a 3D spider. Any feedback on the movement?
author: Adventurous_Eye_6199
selftext:
Hey everyone, I’m pretty new to 3D modeling and animation. I just finished animating this spider for my game and would love to get your thoughts on how the movement looks.

Does the leg motion feel natural, or are there any areas I can improve? Thanks in advance!

comments.author: dominofallsgame
comments.body: Well shoot I’m spooked so you got me!

comments.author: FabulusGames
comments.body: Looks pretty good to me. Some clipping on the back legs. What kind of game is it?

replies.author: Adventurous_Eye_6199
replies.body: Haven't decided yet, just fucking around and finding out.

comments.author: Putrid_Clue_2127
comments.body: I'd want to see the spider movement animation on a contrasting background, like a light gray floor, and without the purple circles to be able to really get down in there and tell. But from this distance I think it looks great!

replies.author: Adventurous_Eye_6199
replies.body: Thanks for the comment! Yeah, I was trying to set the mood, which definitely ended up making things a bit hard to see.

replies.author: Putrid_Clue_2127
replies.body: Mood wise for the game, I think it's a great look!

comments.author: freqCake
comments.body:
I am sure the feet could be rigged up in a few diff ways, but being able to remove legs is impressive and the jumping all looks nice. It moves fast enough that the legs being a little weird will never matter but also add to it seeming creepy.

  
I would leave this where it is, don't fix what aint broke

comments.author: Reasonable_Owl_3146
comments.body:
The back legs are clipping into the body a bit excessively, and there is a glitchy looking switch/jump at the end of the leap animation (when it returns to the floor). 

Separately, and more of a matter of taste, I think the head and body could put a bit more weight into the attack you showed at the beginning to make it look more realistic. I'd also make the body+head move just slightly more as the spider moves around, unless it's supposed to be a robot spider.

Overall though: it's really good how the legs adapt to the changing floor elevation levels, I'm impressed.

comments.author: Kalicola
comments.body: It takes way too small steps. Looks unnatural.. But it’s a great start 🙂👍
